extras.title: Check your National Insurance record
extras.verdict: Clean Markdown of the main content only (no nav/cookie banner), links kept. Current ('up to the start of the current tax year (6 April 2026)'). Answers the 'check' half fully (sign in, what it shows, statement by post/phone, Isle of Man note); for paying voluntary contributions it only links to /voluntary-national-insurance-contributions, so a second scrape would be needed. Score as a reader: 2.

extras.title: Use Custom Email Domain with iCloud Mail - Apple Support (UK)
extras.verdict: No redirect. Clean Markdown, includes 'Published Date: September 30, 2026'. Explains limits (5 domains, 10 addresses each), requirements (2FA, iCloud Mail) and sharing, but the actual step-by-step and DNS records are on the linked iCloud.com guide (support.apple.com/guide/icloud/mma473945269), which was not fetched. Score as a reader: 2.
